meetings.title: Joint Report Planning: New Chinese Playbook for Going Global

decisions.text: Remove the videos panel from the knowledge website homepage.
Incorporate indices (BCI, BSI) into the knowledge homepage.
Prioritize Asia Star and Intelligent China programs for SEO and content efforts.
Defer US partnership programs (Stanford, Columbia) for now, but consider Berkeley as a third priority.
Website menu categorization by topics is correct.
Only one press release for Shun Tian Shu, not two.
Media Minds is likely the best agency choice considering budget and timeline.
The report will be jointly published by CKGSB and IE, with the working title 'The New Chinese Playbook for Going Global'.
